Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of Blu Ginger Investment Pty Ltd trading as Blu Ginger Indian Restaurant

ABN: 90 125 948 754

Date Posted: 03rd July 2026

Position: Cook

Basis of Employment: Full-time (38 hours per week)

Location of workplace: 2/5-21 Genge St, Canberra ACT 2600

Salary: $80,000 to $85,000 + 12% Superannuation

Blu Ginger is an iconic fine dining restaurant located in Canberra serving Indian cuisine and are looking for 2 Full-time Cooks to work 38 hours per week.

To be considered for the role the candidate will need to have a minimum of 2 years' full-time work experience preferably in Indian cuisine.

The ideal candidate must think innovatively and can work in a team.

Duties & Responsibilities:

•	Preparing, seasoning, and cooking food according to the menu and recipes provided.

•	Checking the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.

•	Season food, sauces and gravies during cooking.

•	Following recipes, portion control, and presentation requirements.

•	Assisting with daily food preparation tasks.

•	Ensuring meals are prepared in a timely manner during busy service periods.

•	Monitoring food stock levels and assisting with ordering supplies when required.

•	Storing food correctly in line with food safety and hygiene standards.

•	Cleaning kitchen equipment, work areas, and cooking utensils.

•	Following workplace health and safety procedures at all times.

•	Working cooperatively with chefs, kitchen staff, and front-of-house staff.

•	Minimising food wastage and maintaining cost-effective kitchen practices.

•	Ensuring all food is prepared safely and complies with relevant hygiene regulations.

Qualifications required for the role:

•	Minimum of Certificate III in Commercial Cookery or relevant qualification.

Skills and other requirements for the position:

•	Have a minimum of 2 years' full-time work experience as a cook.

•	Excellent presentation and communication skills.

•	Have knowledge of Food Handling and Food Safety procedures.

•	Ability to work under pressure.

•	Awareness of food safety and hygiene standards.

If you are a passionate and skilled chef with a flair for Indian cuisine, eager to contribute to a dynamic team in a vibrant fine dining environment, we would love to hear from you. Blu Ginger offers a supportive workplace, opportunities to develop your culinary skills, and the chance to be part of an iconic Canberra dining experience. Apply now and send your resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au to join our team and help us deliver exceptional dining to our guests.

Note: Only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.
